icons.name: nsm-home
icons.label: Home
icons.idea: A little house. The door opens and a moss light turns on inside.
icons.motion: The door swings open on hover and closes when the hover ends.

icons.name: nsm-dashboard
icons.label: Dashboard
icons.idea: Three round bars and a moss dot on the tallest.
icons.motion: The bars drop and regrow one after another. The dot pops last.

icons.name: nsm-packaging
icons.label: Packaging
icons.meaning: The Ideation boards where titles and thumbnails are packaged.
icons.idea: A friendly box. The lid lifts and a moss spark rises out.
icons.motion: The lid lifts and the spark rises on hover. Both settle back when the hover ends.

icons.name: nsm-production
icons.label: Production
icons.meaning: The board where videos are filmed and edited.
icons.idea: A clapperboard with a moss play mark.
icons.motion: The clapper claps twice. The play mark ticks on the second clap.

icons.name: nsm-keystone
icons.label: Keystone
icons.idea: A stone arch. The top stone is moss, the keystone that holds the arch.
icons.motion: The keystone lifts, drops with a small thud and settles.

icons.name: nsm-inspiration
icons.label: Inspiration
icons.idea: A round-cornered star with a moss spark beside it.
icons.motion: The star turns one point and swells. The spark twinkles.

icons.name: nsm-network
icons.label: Network
icons.idea: A moss hub with three linked account nodes.
icons.motion: The nodes pulse one after another and the hub swells.

icons.name: nsm-improvements
icons.label: Improvements
icons.meaning: Feedback and rule changes for the pipeline steps.
icons.idea: Three sliders. One knob is moss.
icons.motion: The knobs slide to new places on hover and slide back when the hover ends.

icons.name: nsm-tracking
icons.label: Tracking
icons.idea: Two linked chain rings. One ring is moss.
icons.motion: The rings pull apart and snap back together.

icons.name: nsm-requests
icons.label: Requests
icons.meaning: Requests to the team that are waiting.
icons.idea: A speech bubble with a moss plus.
icons.motion: The plus turns a quarter and swells.

icons.name: nsm-prints
icons.label: Prints
icons.idea: A small cube, the thing being printed. The inner edges are moss.
icons.motion: The inner edges draw in again, like a part being built.

icons.name: nsm-updates
icons.label: Updates
icons.meaning: What changed in the app, with an unread count.
icons.idea: A bell with a moss clapper.
icons.motion: The bell rings and the swing dies down.

icons.name: nsm-settings
icons.label: Settings
icons.meaning: The settings page (the gear beside the account).
icons.idea: A gear with a moss hub ring.
icons.motion: The gear turns one tooth. It looks the same at the end.

icons.name: nsm-collapse
icons.label: Collapse sidebar
icons.meaning: The handle that collapses or expands the sidebar. Set data-flip to point it the other way.
icons.idea: A panel edge with an arrow. The edge is moss.
icons.motion: The arrow nudges toward the edge and settles.

icons.name: nsm-sun
icons.label: Light theme
icons.idea: A sun with eight rays and a moss core.
icons.motion: The rays turn one step and the core swells.

icons.name: nsm-moon
icons.label: Dark theme
icons.idea: A crescent moon with two moss stars.
icons.motion: The moon tips back and returns. The stars twinkle.

icons.name: nsm-stages
icons.label: Stages
icons.meaning: The phone tab for the stage boards.
icons.idea: A board with three columns. A small moss card sits in the first.
icons.motion: The card hops into the second column and hops back.

icons.name: nsm-more
icons.label: More
icons.meaning: The phone tab that opens the rest of the menu.
icons.idea: Three dots. The middle one is moss.
icons.motion: The dots hop in a wave.

icons.name: nsm-macro
icons.label: Macro
icons.idea: Four cells. The top-right cell is moss.
icons.motion: The moss cell and the cell below it swap places on hover and swap back when the hover ends.
